def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Zero is transparent. Overlay panels divided by a solid nonzero line,
    # preserving their local coordinates; overlapping nonzero cells become 2.
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h)
                    if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        top, bottom = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
        n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        return [[2 if top[i][j] != 0 and bottom[i][j] != 0 else 0
                 for j in range(w)] for i in range(n)]
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))), None)
    if sep_col is not None:
        n = min(sep_col, w - sep_col - 1)
        return [[2 if grid[r][j] != 0 and grid[r][sep_col + 1 + j] != 0 else 0
                 for j in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('No nonzero monochrome separator found')
